skill.name: fal-generate
skill.description: Generate images and videos using fal.ai AI models.
skill.summary: Guides image and video generation workflows with fal.ai models.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The two static network findings are documentation links to the upstream GitHub source, not executable network behavior. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or business-logic abuse was found in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL is front matter metadata pointing to the upstream SKILL.md source. It is not executable code and does not cause network access or data transfer.
The URL is a documentation link to the source repository. The prompt-only skill contains no command, fetch call, or instruction to send user data to that URL.

content.value_statement: AI media creation needs clear model guidance and well-scoped prompts. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code plan fal.ai image and video generation tasks.
actual_capabilities: Guides prompts for image generation using fal.ai AI models.
Guides prompts for video generation using fal.ai AI models.
Explains when the skill fits media generation work.
Provides a source repository link for upstream review.
Frames generation requests as reusable workflow patterns.
limitations: Does not include executable code or a fal.ai API client.
Requires the user to manage fal.ai access outside the skill.
Does not choose exact model parameters automatically.
Generated media quality depends on prompts and selected models.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Visuals
use_cases.description: Plan image prompts for ads, social posts, and landing page concepts.

use_cases.title: Prototype Video Concepts
use_cases.description: Draft short video generation prompts before testing fal.ai models.

use_cases.title: Build Media Workflows
use_cases.description: Document repeatable prompt patterns for AI-assisted image and video work.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Image Prompt
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one image concept.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use fal-generate to create a clear image prompt for a product photo. Include subject, setting, lighting, and style.

prompt_templates.title: Video Concept Prompt
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a short video idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use fal-generate to draft a video generation prompt for a five second product reveal. Include motion, camera direction, and mood.

prompt_templates.title: Prompt Variant Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Use fal-generate to create three prompt variants for one visual goal. Make each variant test a different style direction.

prompt_templates.title: Workflow Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for a repeatable media workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use fal-generate to outline an image and video generation workflow for a launch campaign. Include prompt structure, review steps, and iteration criteria.

output_examples.input: Create an image prompt for a clean smartwatch product visual.
output_examples.output: A concise product image prompt with subject, material details, studio lighting, neutral background, and composition guidance.

output_examples.input: Create a short video prompt for a fashion lookbook clip.
output_examples.output: A video prompt describing model motion, camera movement, lighting, setting, pacing, and visual style.

output_examples.input: Create three visual directions for a mobile app launch.
output: A polished product mockup direction for app store assets.
A lifestyle direction showing the app in daily use.
A cinematic motion direction for a launch teaser.

best_practices: State the medium, subject, style, and constraints before asking for output.
Review fal.ai model requirements before running generated prompts.
Iterate with small prompt changes so results stay comparable.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for vague media like a nice image without direction.
Do not include private customer data in generation prompts.
Do not assume generated media is licensed for every commercial use.

faq.question: Does this skill call the fal.ai API?
faq.answer: No. It provides prompt guidance and workflow patterns, but includes no executable API client.

faq.question: Can it generate both images and videos?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is intended for fal.ai image and video generation planning.

faq.question: Does it require a fal.ai account?
faq.answer: You need your own fal.ai access when you run prompts through fal.ai models.

faq.question: Can Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does it choose the best fal.ai model?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure requests, but users should choose models based on project needs.

faq.question: Is private data safe in prompts?
faq.answer: Avoid private or regulated data in prompts unless your fal.ai workflow is approved for that data.
